description: This is a test class for the EmployeeDao component within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It contains unit tests for various methods related to employee data retrieval, hierarchy, email availability, and deletion functionalities.

classes.name: EmployeeDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for verifying the functionality of the EmployeeDao class related to employee data operations in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the EmployeeDao instance and sets up test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateIdListBySupervisorId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate IDs for a given supervisor ID with different parameters.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList
methods.description: Verifies fetching the list of subordinates for a specific employee.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_Simple2LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Tests subordinate list retrieval in a simple two-level hierarchy.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateList_ReportingChain_3LevelHierarchy
methods.description: Tests subordinate list retrieval in a three-level hierarchy.

methods.name: testIsSupervisor
methods.description: Checks if an employee is identified correctly as a supervisor.

methods.name: getEmployeeIds
methods.description: Utility method to extract employee IDs from a list of Employee objects.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdList
methods.description: Verifies that all employee IDs are retrieved correctly.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeIdListOneEmployee
methods.description: Tests ID retrieval when only one employee is present in the database.

methods.name: testGetSupervisorIdListBySubordinateId
methods.description: Checks retrieval of supervisor IDs for a subordinate.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeWorkShift
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of employee work shift details.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeList
methods.description: Checks retrieval of employee list with various filtering and sorting options.

methods.name: testGetEmpNumbersByFilterParams
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of employee numbers based on filter parameters.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeCount
methods.description: Tests the count of employees matching specific filters.

methods.name: testGetEmailList
methods.description: Verifies the list of employee emails.
